about: How an official's term is read by policy area (owner, Nov 8: 'if you're having a good term except for education, then you might get a strike... this needs to work with the entire game'). Each area is a few of the outcome web's own measures with the direction that is better (+1 when more is better, -1 when less is). The read of an area is how far its measures moved since the term began, as a slide between -1 (as bad as the scale) and 1 (as good); nothing flips at a point. It holds no sentence and decides nothing: the director's addresses and the groups' reactions read it.

fullChange.note: The relative change in a measure over a term that reads as most of the way better or worse (a slide of about 0.76 through tanh). Checked against how far the web's measures move over a decade of a played world.

minimumMonths.note: The fewest months of web rows an area is read over; a term shorter than this is not read yet (the web writes one row a month).

warmupMonths.note: The months a world's town needs before its records show a trend and not the settling in from the records it opened with. Read from one played year in Algiers, Vermont (seed r7): unemployment ran 0.3 percent to 5.7 percent and poverty 9.6 percent to 18.6 percent across the first twelve months and was still rising in the fourteenth. The warm-up is a stopgap for that drift (SG-WORDS-term-read-warmup): the economy's start is the owner of the fix.
